query: WITH LatestSnapshot AS (SELECT MAX(snapshot) AS latest_snapshot FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala), FilteredPopulation AS (SELECT id FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala WHERE snapshot = (SELECT latest_snapshot FROM LatestSnapshot) AND is_in_population = true) SELECT hl.region, COUNT(DISTINCT fp.id) AS population_count FROM FilteredPopulation fp JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location hl ON fp.id = hl.id WHERE hl.region IN ('منطقة الرياض', 'منطقة مكة المكرمة') GROUP BY hl.region ORDER BY population_count DESC LIMIT 1200
